title: scFlex 0.1.1
text: Added automatic detection joining split Seurat v5 Assay5 layers counts.sample1, counts.sample2, matching data.* layers. Counts-Seurat objects can now written AnnData without normalization; counts placed X layers["counts"] explicit conversion note. inspect_sc() now reports detected count normalized-data layer groups Assay5 objects. check_input_info() retained compatibility wrapper points users inspect_sc(). Improved assay-cell, feature-metadata, reduction alignment Seurat extraction.

title: scFlex 0.1.0
text: Initial development release. Adds common convert_sc() interface Seurat, SingleCellExperiment, AnnData, Loom. Preserves aligned counts, normalized expression, cell/feature metadata, compatible dimensional reductions. Adds Seurat classic Assay <-> Assay5 conversion helpers. Uses reticulate::py_require() instead hard-coded Conda environment.
